title.narrative: Support Education systems governance and the realization of the right to education

description.narrative: UNESCO Maghreb will support countries in the region in strengthening education governance, policy dialogue and evidence-based decision-making through technical assistance, policy advice and knowledge production. Building on UNESCO’s normative mandate and lifelong learning approach, the Office will support context-specific analyses on the realization of the right to education and inclusive education systems. UNESCO will support the national diagnosis on the right to education in the Maghreb countries, including gender dimensions and lifelong learning perspectives, contributing to policy reflection and implementation. Regional exchanges and peer learning among Maghreb countries will also be promoted.
